reason: RTL registers every data pin on its declared root: inputs fi (f_collective), hc_q (hc), ss1 (f_sseq_st), wf (f_wfc_ft), lf_pins (f_lf); outputs to (t_collective), hw, t_sseq_pw / t_pq_pw / t_sseq_plen (ckv). A generic single-clock wrapper would mis-clock the ckv outputs and add a duplicate stage.
